contract.description: A repeated branch ladder and a direct lookup implement the same closed mapping.

overbuilt.content: export function code(value: string) { if (value === 'red') return 1; if (value === 'green') return 2; return 0; }

minimal.content:
const codes: Record<string, number> = { green: 2, red: 1 };
export const code = (value: string) => codes[value] ?? 0;
